title: King Ahaz: Idolatry and Alliance with Assyria
description: King Ahaz introduces idolatry in Judah, makes his own son pass through the fire, and allies himself with Tiglath-Pileser, king of Assyria, to save himself from Aram and Israel. He travels to Damascus, sends a drawing of a foreign altar to priest Uria who builds it, and has it replace the bronze altar in front of the house of the Lord. To accommodate the king of Assyria, he also removes several temple furnishings.
